inclusion: Original human outcomes, reference distributions and applicable official guidance. Independent follow-ups share cohort IDs. Clinical rules require pediatric review.
exclusions: Wrong topic, mirrors, commercial summaries when originals available, unsupported extrapolations and retracted primary evidence. Nonselected results were not all formally screened.
limitations: No exhaustive MEDLINE/Embase/Europe PMC export, citation-network sweep or comprehensive Crossref corrections/COI audit. Null fields require completion against full text and supplements.
